summary: Wearable Devices Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Special General Meeting of Shareholders held on June 4, 2026. The meeting was initially convened but lacked a quorum, was adjourned, and reconvened, at which point shareholders approved a proposal detailed in a prior proxy statement. No specific terms, stakes, prices, or deal mechanics are disclosed; the filing solely confirms procedural shareholder approval, lacking any acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special-situation event. The filing is a routine corporate governance update with no transaction or event of the sort required by special-situations analysis.
